tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-7For $w > 0$, let $M_w \subseteq \mathbb {R}^3$ be the surface of revolution obtained by revolving the curve $\gamma (t) = (w \cosh (t/w), t)$ around the $z$-axis, called a catenoid. Show that $M_w$ is a minimal surface for each $w$. \end{exercise}
